sporeGate.role: GUT — inner node, workshop, Brio webcam

dag_properties.directed: Data flows: WAN → tik2 → (tik1 → gates) + (JetStream → House 2)
dag_properties.acyclic: No loops. tik2 is root. Each gate has ONE primary parent path.
dag_properties.redundancy: Multiple parent edges (not cycles): eastGate has fiber+WiFi, sporeGate has tik1+Flint
dag_properties.rhizoCrypt: DAG-rooted encryption — each node derives keys from parent path to root
